🎬 **Szukam odtwórców do teledysku!**

Szukam **pary chłopak - dziewczyna (lub dwóch osób, które nie mają problemu z odegraniem pary)** do teledysku do mojej autorskiej piosenki. 

Zarówno utwór, jak i klip opowiadają o miłości, dlatego zależy mi na naturalnej chemii przed kamerą.

📍 **Warszawa**
🕒 **Jeden dzień zdjęciowy** (kilka godzin, wieczorem)

Niestety jest to **projekt non profit**

Realizuję go z własnej pasji i obecnie nie dysponuję budżetem na wynagrodzenie.

Jeśli macie ochotę wziąć udział albo znacie kogoś, kto mógłby być zainteresowany, napiszcie do mnie na priv.

Pozdrawiam

Casting do 3. Edycji programu „Żona dla Polaka”! 

Po sukcesie dwóch poprzednich edycji w Chicago i Toronto startujemy z kolejną odsłoną programu. Tym razem kierunek Australia! 

Ruszamy do Melbourne, a już niedługo odkryjemy tożsamość naszych uczestników.

Szukamy singli i singielek (20–60 lat), którzy marzą o miłości i są gotowi na przygodę życia.

Zgłoś się – miłość nie zna granic!

Zapraszamy do kontaktu w wiadomości prywatnej.

«LE JEU À L’IMAGE : PRATIQUES & TECHNIQUES FACE CAMÉRA (DIRIGÉE PAR 10 RESPONSABLES DE DISTRIBUTION ARTISTIQUE)»
FORMATION INTENSIVE DE 10 JOURS | AFDAS | MARSEILLE |

Du 14 au 25 septembre 2026 inclus (week-end off)

Cette formation s’adresse à des comédien.ne.s professionnel.le.s souhaitant perfectionner leur jeu face caméra dans un cadre exigeant. Elle met l’accent sur la justesse de l’interprétation, l’analyse dramaturgique et la qualité de présence à l’image à travers des scènes filmées en conditions professionnelles. 

Le visionnage collectif et les retours individualisés permettent des ajustements concrets et immédiats. Encadrée par plusieurs responsables de distribution artistique, elle développe l’autonomie, l’adaptabilité et affirme la singularité artistique de chaque participant.e.

Vous rencontrerez et travaillerez avec les 10 responsables de distribution artistiques suivant.e.s >>>

Ami(e)s intermittent(e)s du spectacle proches de la retraite : A lire attentivement !
Une information extraite du journal du SFA sur la suppression du cumul emploi retraite intégral jusqu’à 67 ans même pour celles et ceux qui prennent leur retraite à taux plein ! C’est à compter du 1er janvier 2027. 
Pour les personnes nées en 1963 et 1964 qui ont tous leurs trimestres, il est fortement conseillé de prendre sa retraite avant le 31 décembre 2026 pour pouvoir bénéficier des conditions actuelles c’est à dire sans plafond de revenus avec des cachets ou autres.

sharedPost.text:
CALL FOR COMPOSERS: (Short Film)

Genre: Drama / Psychological Thriller

Synopsis: Driven to the breaking point by his father's violent alcoholism, a desperate teenager commits a fatal act of rebellion to save his family—only to find that the price of their freedom is a suffocating, inescapable guilt.

✨ What we are looking for ✨

We are seeking talented and passionate Film Composers to create an original score that brings the emotional depth, tension, and tragedy of this story to life.

The ideal candidate will be able to translate complex psychological themes—trauma, desperation, relief, and crushing guilt—into a powerful soundscape. Whether your style relies on subtle minimalist acoustics, haunting ambient textures, or brooding orchestral elements, we want to hear your vision!

✨ Project Details & Compensation ✨

Type: Independent Short Film
Compensation: Unpaid 
Credit: Full screen credit and official IMDb credit provided.
Perks: High-quality footage for your reel/portfolio, full festival exposure, and a collaborative environment with a dedicated creative team.

📩 How to Apply 📩

If you are interested in scoring this short film, please send us the following:

Name & Contact Information
A link to your showreel, portfolio, or Spotify/SoundCloud (please highlight tracks with dramatic or thriller tones)
A brief introduction about yourself and why this story resonates with you.

📩 Send us a DM Madhouse Productions or Creativery Arts 
📅 Deadline for Submissions: 10th August 2026
#callforcomposers #shortfilm #Comingfall2026

items.text:
🎬 It’s a wrap! 🎬

What an incredible week of filming! I honestly couldn’t be prouder of every one of our child and adult actors from our Academy and Talent Agency. From long days and night shoots to the early hours of the morning, every moment has been worth it.
In all my years on film sets, I can genuinely say I’ve never seen such respectful, hardworking and well-behaved children. That’s not me being biased, that’s me speaking as an agent, principal teacher and a mum. You have all represented yourselves, your families and our Academy so beautifully. 💜
For many of our children and adults, this was their very first professional filming experience. It isn’t always glamorous, but the confidence, resilience and memories they’ve gained are priceless.
A huge thank you to our incredible parents for your patience, support and commitment. Those long hours were yours too, and some of you even got a little behind-the-scenes glimpse of life on set. We couldn’t do this without you. 💜
This may be a wrap for now, but we’re back on set from August through to November, with even more exciting opportunities ahead for our talented Academy family.
📸 Here’s a cheeky little behind-the-scenes sneak peek! We have so much more to share, but for now we can’t give too much away… 🤫
The future is looking incredibly bright, and I couldn’t be prouder. 💜💛

#ItsAWrap #BehindTheScenes #TalentAgency #ActingAcademy #YoungActors

sharedPost.text:
A L C A L I N E HORROR
ambient electronic, happy ambient music, deep space ambient, cinematic ambient soundscape, modular synth ambient, eurorack ambient music, happy trap ambient, uplifting ambient music, atmospheric electronic music, meditation ambient music, sci fi ambient soundscape, modular synthesizer music, space ambient soundtrack, experimental ambient music, deep ambient textures, relaxing ambient music, cosmic ambient music, electronic ambient soundscape, ambient space journey, modular ambient soundscape, Didier Junk
These instrumental compositions combine ambient electronic textures, deep space soundscapes, and subtle trap-inspired harmonic movement, creating an atmosphere that feels both peaceful and uplifting while remaining cinematic and immersive.
The music moves slowly at 56–58 BPM, allowing each sound to breathe within wide and spacious sonic environments. Instead of traditional percussion, the rhythmic pulse emerges from delicate telemetry beeps and subtle electronic signals, echoing like distant communications drifting through the silence of space.
The sonic palette is built from pure sine layers, marine noise textures, and immense cathedral reverbs, creating a floating and weightless atmosphere. Long tape-delay echoes stretch tones across vast sonic horizons, reinforcing the feeling of endless cosmic distance.
Occasionally, faint French whispers and calm radio-style speech appear like fragments of distant transmissions, adding a subtle human presence to the expansive soundscape.
While the overall aesthetic remains serene and atmospheric, ALCALINE – Happy Trap introduces moments of light, warmth, and quiet happiness within the ambient environment. The music evokes the feeling of peaceful exploration, optimism, and calm wonder, as if drifting through a tranquil region of the cosmos.

**CASTING CALL:**

Hello everyone!

I'm currently casting **Solitaire**, an upcoming independent short film shooting in the GTA this August, and we're looking for talented actors to join our cast.

**Project:** *Solitaire* (Short Film)
**Location:** Greater Toronto Area
**Shoot Dates:** August 17–18 & August 24–25, with a scheduled pick-up day on August 27.
* NON UNION/ NON PAID
* Food and beverages will be provided

If you're interested, you can:
* Apply through our Backstage casting notice:
https://www.backstage.com/casting/solitaire-3199900/

**OR** email your submission directly to **damirshahi@gmail.com** with:
* Headshot
* Resume
* Demo reel (if available)

**ROLE:**

NEIL

GENDER: MALE

AGE: 40-60

A middle-aged (late 40s, early 50s) man who believes he is still a 17-year-old high school student serving detention in 1990. Neil creates an imaginary life for himself in detention, and is kept company by a sock puppet friend, Mikey, whom Neil voices. Neil is easily impressionable, cocky, immature, and not the sharpest tool in the shed.

Thank you, and I look forward to seeing your submissions!

**CASTING CALL – PAID + EXPENSES COVERED | GERMANY | SEPTEMBER 2026**

We're casting for **These Little Moments**, a heartfelt coming-of-age drama set in 2002 about four childhood friends reuniting for one final summer road trip before tragedy changes everything.

We're looking for actors **playing ages 20–27** for four lead roles:

**JAMES (20–27)**
The geeky guy who overthinks every move he makes. He has had a secret crush on Emma for ages but never quite had the guts to ask her out, always telling himself he could wait for the right moment. Over the course of the trip, he learns that the right moment doesn't always come, and that if he truly cares about something, he has to act.

**RUBY (20–27)**
The caring leader and enthusiastic glue of the group. She has always loved living in their small town and never questioned it, but lately, watching her friends leave one by one, she has started to doubt the choices she made. Underneath the big energy is someone quietly afraid of being the one left behind.

**EMMA (20–27)**
An optimistic girl who hides her fears behind a smile. She left their hometown young to study fashion, and she still wavers between chasing her dreams and the pull of the life she left behind. Now she has a once-in-a-lifetime chance in front of her, but her own dark thoughts hold her back and leave her yearning for somewhere that feels safe.

**ELIO (20–27)**
The lovable stoner who doesn't have big dreams and is perfectly fine with that. He loves music and looks forward to a simple life running a small CD shop. His laid-back demeanour makes people think he doesn't care, but beneath it, he is devoted to his friends, filming every moment of the holiday because he can't imagine life without them.

 **Shooting:** Germany (Berlin/Brandenburg)
 **Dates:** 8–17 September 2026
 **Language:** English

If you're interested, please send your **CV/showreel**, a **short introduction**, which **character you'd like to play**, and **why the project intrigued you** to:

**crasherscollective@gmail.com**

Feel free to share this post with anyone who might be a great fit—we can't wait to hear from you!

++ 🔥Wenn der Metal die Hölle entfesselt... 🔥++

Ab August 2027 entsteht auf dem Gelände des Rock the Farm Langerringen  Festivals eine Horrorcomedy, die das Metal-Genre auf den Kopf stellen könnte.

Was passiert, wenn ein friedliches Heavy-Metal-Festival plötzlich zum Epizentrum einer Dämoneninvasion wird?

Genau diese Frage soll ab August 2027 auf dem legendären ROCK THE FARM-Gelände in Langerringen beantwortet werden – dort, wo jedes Jahr echte Metalheads gemeinsam feiern, soll schon bald das Grauen Einzug halten. 

Doch keine Sorge: Zwischen blutigen Monstern, höllischen Kreaturen und dem drohenden Weltuntergang bleibt reichlich Platz für rabenschwarzen Humor, absurde Situationen und jede Menge Heavy Metal.

Stellt euch vor:

Ein Festival. Hunderte Metalfans. Gitarren. Schlagzeug. Bier. Moshpits. Die lautesten Bands des Abends...

...und plötzlich öffnet sich mitten auf dem Gelände ein Tor zur Hölle.

Während Dämonen das Festival übernehmen und Chaos ausbricht, müssen ausgerechnet Musiker, Crew-Mitglieder und Besucher zusammenhalten. Denn wer glaubt, dass nur Weihwasser gegen das Böse hilft, kennt die Macht einer voll aufgedrehten Metalmeute noch nicht...

Die Macher sprechen von einer Liebeserklärung an die Metal-Szene. Wer Festivals kennt, wird unzählige Anspielungen entdecken. Wer Horror liebt, darf sich auf dämonische Kreaturen, übernatürliche Eskalationen und spektakuläre Effekte freuen. 

Und wer schwarzen Humor mag, könnte hier seinen neuen Kultfilm finden.

Eines steht jedoch schon jetzt fest:

Ab August 2027 wird auf dem ROCK THE FARM-Gelände nicht nur Metal gespielt - dort wird die Hölle ihre Tore öffnen, die Verstärker werden beben und die Nacht wird blutrot.

Vielleicht beginnt genau hier der lauteste, verrückteste und durchgeknallteste Horrorfilm, den die deutsche Metal-Szene jemals gesehen hat.

Und mit im aktuellen Team sind Menschen, die unter andrem bei folgenden Projekten vor und/oder hinter der Kamera standen: 

- LEVIZIA 
- ⁠START YOUNG 
- ⁠THE LAST TRAIN 
- ⁠DARK DAYZ 
- ⁠VHS: UNDERGROUND 1+2
- ⁠PUPPENMACHER
- ⁠WRONGFUL DEATH 
- ⁠ONG BAK 
- ⁠STREETFIGHTER: CHUN LI  
- ⁠BELLY OF THE BEAST 
- ⁠BIG GAME - DIE JAGD BEGINNT 
- ⁠DAS MEDDAILLON (mit Jackie Chan)
- ⁠MATRIX 4 (!!!) 

Und wenn du Teil davon sein willst: 

Wir suchen noch: 

👉 Metal-Statisten 

👉 Leute mit Erfahrung im Bereich Special Effects

👉 Leute, die uns hinter der Kamera aushelfen 

👉Co-Producer (inkl. rechtsgültigem Vertrag), die Teil des Projekts sein wollen!

🔥Stay tuned. Denn das ist erst der Anfang… 🔥

@Follower 
Erik Markus Schuetz Jean Rises elina.mj Christian Matthesius Sprachrohr Eisregen #Inanis KveldulF Spanky Ham 

#heavymetal #comedy #movie #Splatter #Horror #fun #specialeffects #festival

K.A. Global Pictures is casting for an upcoming British Feature Television Drama Series currently in development.

We are seeking experienced Male Actors with strong dramatic ability and, ideally, some action or physical performance experience for the following roles:

- 2 x Hard Men
- 1 Corrupt Police Officer (Plain Clothes) 

Due to the confidential nature of the project, further production details will only be disclosed to shortlisted applicants.

This production is being developed by an Award-Winning Writer & Director following the success of a critically praised theatre production that received outstanding audience and industry feedback. The project is now being adapted for the screen and has generated early interest from major broadcasters and streaming platforms.

Inspired by True Events spanning the 1980s through to the present day, this British crime drama blends realism, grit and suspense in the style of Snatch, Gangs of London, The Gentlemen, Essex Boys, Rise of the Footsoldier, This Is Our City, Mobland and Layer Cake.

Genre: Drama | Crime | Thriller

Who We're Looking For?

* British White/Caucasian Male Actors
* Late 30s, 40s and 50s
* London-based applicants preferred
* Previous acting experience essential
* Action or physical performance experience desirable

We're particularly interested in performers who can authentically portray tough, streetwise British characters with confidence and realism. Familiarity with Cockney culture, London "geezer" personalities, British popular culture and the criminal underworld portrayed in classic British dramas is advantageous. Think along the lines of iconic characters such as Phil Mitchell and Grant Mitchell.

Audition Process?

Auditions will be conducted via self-tape.

Successful applicants will progress through the following stages:

* Application review
* Casting interview
* Self-tape audition
* Character discussions and project briefing
* Final casting decisions

Shortlisted actors will also be invited to attend professional character development workshops and rehearsal sessions at our Camden, North London production hub.

Rehearsals & Character Development?

Successful applicants will benefit from:

* Professional character development workshops
* Sessions with experienced acting coaches
* Opportunities to perform in front of visiting industry professionals and talent representatives
* Rehearsals based at our Camden, London hub
* Refreshments and facilities provided
* Full rehearsal schedules issued in advance

Availability?

Applicants should have reasonable flexibility throughout rehearsals and filming. You will not be required every day; however, availability for scheduled rehearsals and production dates is essential.

We are seeking experienced Male Actors with strong dramatic ability and, ideally, some action or physical performance experience for the following roles:

- 2 x Hard Men
- 1 Corrupt Police Officer (Plain Clothes) 

Due to the confidential nature of the project, further production details will only be disclosed to shortlisted applicants.

This production is being developed by an Award-Winning Writer & Director following the success of a critically praised theatre production that received outstanding audience and industry feedback. The project is now being adapted for the screen and has generated early interest from major broadcasters and streaming platforms.

Inspired by True Events spanning the 1980s through to the present day, this British crime drama blends realism, grit and suspense in the style of Snatch, Gangs of London, The Gentlemen, Essex Boys, Rise of the Footsoldier, This Is Our City, Mobland and Layer Cake.

Genre: Drama | Crime | Thriller

Who We're Looking For?

* British White/Caucasian Male Actors
* Late 30s, 40s and 50s
* London-based applicants preferred
* Previous acting experience essential
* Action or physical performance experience desirable

Familiarity with Cockney culture, London "geezer" personalities, British popular culture and the criminal underworld portrayed in classic British dramas is advantageous. Think along the lines of iconic characters such as Phil Mitchell and Grant Mitchell.

## 🎬👻 THE SUPERNATURAL HORROR FILM CHALLENGE
**18–28 September | Clonard Studios, France**

**Places are now starting to fill!**

Join us for **10 days** of writing, shooting and editing supernatural horror films inside a **150-year-old French manor house**.

👻 Three Film Challenges:
🩸 24-Hour • 👹 48-Hour • ☠️ 96-Hour

Open to **actors, directors, cinematographers, sound recordists, screenwriters, editors** and anyone passionate about filmmaking.

🎼 Composer in residence
🩸 Horror make-up artist
🏠 Hostel-style accommodation & communal living
🍽️ Three meals a day included

💶 **Total Cost: €500**
HOW TO SECURE YOUR PLACE

📩 Email **[clonardstudios@gmail.com](mailto:clonardstudios@gmail.com)**

Then pay a **€100 deposit** via **Revolut: @bobomeara72**

(If you prefer to pay by bank transfer, email us and we'll send you our bank details.)

The remaining **€400** must be paid by **23 August**.

If the balance has not been received by that date, your deposit will be refunded and your place will be offered to the next person on the waiting list.

⚠️ **Only 15 places are available.** Once they're gone, we'll operate a waiting list in case a place becomes available.

👉 Join the Facebook Group for updates:
[https://www.facebook.com/groups/778669724512874](https://www.facebook.com/groups/778669724512874)

**One manor house. Three horror films. Ten unforgettable days.** 👻🎬

🎬VOLUNTEERS WANTED FOR HELP!

We're looking for passionate people to join our voluntary horror short film, HELP! In Partnership With Byron JJeffect Highton 

🎥 Volunteer Camera Crew
We're looking for 4 people with an iPhone 15, 15 Pro or 15 Pro Max, to help capture cinematic footage during filming. No professional experience is required – if you're reliable, enthusiastic and want to gain on-set experience, we'd love to hear from you.

🧥 Volunteer Props & Costume Support.
Can you help with police uniforms, detective clothing, teenage outfits, or other props that could help bring the story to life? We'd really appreciate your support, and all borrowed items will be treated with care.

📍Filming is planned for late 2026, or early 2027 if needed.

This is a voluntary passion project made to bring together local creatives, actors and filmmakers while building experience and creating something unforgettable.

📩 Get in touch:
📧 [aykaygp@gmail.com]
📱 Instagram: @aykaygp

Please share this post—it could reach the person we're looking for.

items.text: Hello.my name is Johnny I’m originally from New York have been here in California for over 40 years as a actor and have more then 60 years of experience as a actor from a young age .stage movies and tv music videos to touring with the play grease from Broadway 🎭 in 1978 and 79 .when I was just 18 years old I am also a very talented individual with a large range of people I can portray I have worked with a lot of very talented artists on stage tv.movies .voice over .print work and the list goes on . **AUDITION** ***NOTICE***!

The West Allis Players announce auditions for “*FOOLS*” by Neil Simon!

A romantic, comic fable set in the 19th century village of Kulyenchikov. The tale follows a schoolteacher, who arrives to tutor the town doctor’s daughter. He quickly learns that the town is under a 200-year-old curse that makes everyone chronically stupid!

We welcome performers of all backgrounds to audition!

FOOLS Character Descriptions:

• Leon Tolchinsky — An ambitious young schoolteacher, newly arrived in the village of Kulyenchikov. He’s been hired to educate the village doctor’s daughter, Sophia. (Mid 20s to mid-30s - Male)

• Snetsky — An unintelligent shepherd. (20s to 60s - gender non-specific)

• Magistrate — The unwise village judge. (40s plus - gender non-specific)

• Slovitch — An idiotic butcher. (20s to 50s - gender non-specific)

• Mishkin — A foolish postman. (20s to 60s - Male)

• Yenchna — A ridiculous woman, a seller of goods. (20s to 60s – Female)

• Zubritsky — The dimwitted village doctor. (40s to 60s - Male)

• Lenya Zubritsky — The doctor’s equally dimwitted wife. (40s to 60s - Female)

• Sophia Zubritsky — The doctor’s beautiful young daughter, who is so stupid she just recently learned to sit down. (20s to mid-30s - Female)

• Count Gregor Yousekevitch — Ancestor of the man who cast the curse of stupidity on the village of Kulyenchikov. Last in the line of Yousekevitches. (40s plus - Male)

Audition Dates:

August 17 & 18, 2026

6:30 pm

Liberace Auditorium

West Milwaukee Intermediate School

5104 Greenfield Ave.

West Allis, WI 53214

Performance Dates:

October 2, 3, 4, 9, 10 & 11, 2026

PAID invitation to share your story for a documentary,  South Korean TV.
We are currently producing a special documentary on young generation,  especially recent UK graduates facing the tough job market.

This is a global phenomenon. 

Looking for a recent UK graduate (2024- 2025) still searching for their first career step, this documentary is exploring a challenge that defines our times: the incredible tough job market facing today's young generation. 

From South Korea to the UK, we know that millions of highly qualified young people are doing everything right - sending endless applications and navigating ghosting- yet facing unprecedented structural barriers.

Our goal is to amplify your voice and spark a conversation on how society needs to change to support your generation. 

We are looking for recent graduates based in Manchester, Nottingham,  Leeds, Midlands,  Home Counties to share their journey with us.

Filming details ;

- Format : A respectful,  cinematic look at your daily routine and interview. 

("REALITY" format)

- Time Commitment: minimum 2 days, ideally 3 days of filming in your local area and at your place.

We will come to where you are based.

- EXPECTED SHOOTINGS:

Between the 2nd and the 10th Sept 2026

- COMPENSATION: We deeply value your time and commitment,  and offer a competitive daily fee of £400.00

We want to tell this story with the utmost empathy,  dignity, and respect. 

Your perspective could help our viewers understand the true reality of entering the workforce today.

If you are open to a chat and see if this feels like a good fit for you, or if you know someone around you who could be a fit for this, please let me know your availability and we take it from there.

If you are interested in sharing your story, please send us the basic information for us to read you first.

1) your full name / age

2) University attended (Degree) / Graduation Year;

3) Your current situation ; i.e Working part time/ Unemployed/ Internship/ living with parents etc

4) How many CVs sent out.

(ie 0-50? / 50~100?/ 100 +)

5) The worst experience in job hunting .

If you could send all these via email we will read them through get back to you ,if we feel you would be a good fit for our documentary. 

I hope this doesn't sound like job interviews after all !!

How irony.....🙏

Hope to hear from you soon!

This is open until the * 5th of August 2026.

Many thanks.

Gina

www.ginamcdonaldtv.co.uk

ginamcdonaldtv@gmail.com

Hi everyone! I'm an indie filmmaker currently putting the finishing touches on my Spider-Man fan film (years in the making) and I'm looking for a 3D animator who would be interested in helping with one very quick shot.

The shot is a **static camera angle** of Mary Jane sitting by a window. Outside the window, I need a **Spider-Man silhouette swinging past** for just a brief moment. Since it's only a silhouette seen through the window, it doesn't require facial detail or close-up animation—just a smooth swing across frame.

This is a passion project/non-commercial, so my budget is extremely limited, but I'd love to connect with someone who enjoys collaborating on indie films or wants to add a fun, cinematic shot to their portfolio.

If you're interested (or know someone who might be), please comment or email me at sallyklomonaco@gmail.com. I'd be happy to share more details. Thanks so much!

**HMU/Wardrobe CALL for feature film, “Astrogenesis” **

***No phone calls, DMs, texts. ***Emails to [info@astrogenesis.one](mailto:info@astrogenesis.one) only. 

Must work local in Greensboro, NC.

Shoot days August 9th – 12th in Greensboro, NC, 2pm – 10pm.

**Compensation**:  The film is cast and crew owned (no investors, loans, backers etc). Gross first dollar profit sharing plus post-production service barter (one day on set = one day of any post work from Srace Films). All of the crew from director to PA are compensated this way.

[Astrogenesis ](https://astrogenesis.one)(originally Nemesis Eterna) is a SAG Micro-budget (sub $20K) feature film from [Srace Films](https://sracefilms.com/), [ESP CoPro](https://www.espcopro.com/) & [Lunar Kitchen Films](https://tiffany-albright.com/about/) and originally began during the pandemic in North Carolina, USA but halted when filmmaker Victoria Srace Stone was disabled with Complex Regional Pain Syndrome.

Project is trans positive with female/gender-diverse/queer/diverse cast and crew. Director is disabled so shooting days will be 8 hours or less with frequent days off.

**LOGLINE**: *A rebellious trans punk rocker mysteriously linked to a constellation of misfits and lost souls must partner with a hardened documentary journalist to uncover humanity’s alien origins before a shadowy renegade government agent’s machinations destroy Earth.*

LOS ANGELES — SOUND MIXER NEEDED

Hello everybody! 
We are going to participate in the 48 hr film festival taking place this coming weekend. In case you don’t know how this works: 
On Friday evening we are getting a prompt, wich could be a prop, a character, costume or action etc, and we need to write a short script around that. Then we’ll shoot on Saturday all day and edit on Sunday.

Andrew, our director, has participated in this festival last year and really enjoyed it. There will be a screening of all films in about two weeks. 

We have most of our crew and actors who the director has worked with before and will base the script on their abilities and age-ranges.

We only need our SOUND MIXER.
You would only be needed on our shoot day on Saturday, August 1, 2026, probably from 8 AM - 8 PM (tbd). The location will be in South Pasadena with free street parking.

Gear will be provided. 

Due to the 48 hr FF regulations, nobody is permitted to get paid (and we don’t want to cheat!). Therefore, this would be a volunteer position.
If you don’t have much experience but are interested in helping out or are a film student or new to this business who needs credits, please contact us. 

We will provide breakfast, lunch and credit, of course.

We truly hope to hear from you! Join this exciting project and have fun with us! 

Best regards, 

Annette Remter (producer) and Andrew Sego (writer/director/Producer)

Hello everyone! My name is Connie, and I’m based in Temecula, California, originally from Los Angeles.

I was a plus-size model in the late ’90s and early 2000s, and modeling has always been a passion close to my heart. In 2021, my life took an unexpected turn when I was diagnosed with breast cancer. That journey changed me in many ways, but it never took away my love for creating, storytelling, and being in front of the camera.

Today, I’m grateful to be rebuilding my life and stepping back into the world I love. I’m available for modeling, acting, lifestyle, commercial, creative, and collaborative content. I’m located near San Diego and about two hours from Los Angeles, and I’m happy to travel for the right opportunity.

If you’re a photographer, creative, brand, or filmmaker looking to collaborate, I’d love to connect. You can reach me on Instagram.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Here’s to new beginnings, beautiful collaborations, and doing what makes our souls come alive.

Sending love and light to everyone. 🖤✨

https://www.instagram.com/mrs_conniehjarvis?igsh=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

* Positive, energetic, and reliable

**Brand Ambassador – Forme x Erewhon (Los Angeles)**

Forme is building a team of exceptional brand ambassadors for exclusive pop-up events at Erewhon locations across Los Angeles.

As an official partner of the **WNBPA**, **MLB Players Association**, and **Harvard Athletics**, Forme works with leading athletes, healthcare organizations, and wellness communities to help people move, feel, and recover better.

We're looking for energetic, polished, and personable individuals who naturally connect with people and represent premium brands with confidence.

As a Forme Brand Ambassador, you'll engage with customers, educate them on our products, and help create an exceptional in-person brand experience. Throughout the year, you'll also have opportunities to support activations featuring professional athletes, creators, influencers, and other notable partners representing Forme.

**We're looking for people who:**
* Have an outgoing, engaging personality
* Present themselves professionally and confidently
* Have experience with brand activations, events, retail, hospitality, or customer engagement
* Are passionate about wellness, fitness, or premium consumer brands

**Compensation:** Up to $30/hour

**To apply, email ****[hiring@forme.science](mailto:hiring@forme.science)**** with:**
* Subject: BA Application - Forme LA
* Your Instagram profile **or** a headshot
* A short video of you working an event, engaging with customers, demonstrating a product, or similar experience

**Applications without these materials will not be considered.**

items.text:
The biggest role you've ever played... is yourself.

**Most actors spend years learning how to create believable characters, but never question the character they've created off screen.**

"I'm not confident."
"I'm not lead-role material."
"I'm bad at auditions."

Those aren't facts. They're just lines you've rehearsed until they've become your identity.

In this free class, **we explore why talented actors plateau, **why the actor who got you an agent isn't the actor who books lead roles, and how to become the actor your career actually requires.

If you're serious about booking bigger roles, you'll find this valuable.

🎬 Watch the free replay below.

[https://youtu.be/PJ5kyySF7qs?si=UHD__P7y0tfdQUCO](https://youtu.be/PJ5kyySF7qs?si=UHD__P7y0tfdQUCO)

- Aged 40–55 (You don't need to be this age, just need look it)

- Neutral British accent (no overtly strong regional)

- Comfortable on camera with teleprompter or autocue

- Corporate, broadcast or news presenting background preferred

- Available for a 3-hour studio session

📍 Bolton Darren Town

⏱️ 3 hours

💷 £100

Full name

A Headshot

TP Team 🎬

**CASTING CALL: BACKGROUND ACTORS & FEATURED ROLES **

We are currently casting **background actors and featured roles** for an upcoming film production shooting on **August 10th in Middletown, Connecticut**.

We are looking for individuals to help bring a **summer wedding scene** to life, including wedding guests and featured roles.

**Casting Details: **
• Talent must be available for either a **6-hour or 5-hour filming window**.
• **Group A:** 8:00 AM–2:00 PM
• **Group B:** 3:00 PM–8:00 PM
• Talent must **self-report to the filming location** in Middletown, Connecticut.
• All talent must provide their own **summer wedding attire**.

The production will feature **Ryan Eggold** and **Tyler Labine**, known for their roles in the television series *New Amsterdam*. 

If you are interested in participating, please complete the casting form below with your **contact information, current location, photos, availability, and preferred filming group**.

**Casting Form: **https://forms.gle/E7aEYGc2zEMK3rcVA

Please feel free to share this post with anyone who may be interested in participating.

items.text:
**CHAPMAN UNIVERSITY CASTING CALL**

Title: The Sister

Logline: When a group of teenage girls engage in a series of pranks, one prank phone call threatens to expose the casual cruelty of girlhood. 

Shooting Date: Sunday, August 2nd

Hours: 10AM-4PM

Location: Orange ,CA

E-mail: moraleslopez@chapman.edu

Compensation: copy of film and credit are provided

JESSICA (15, LATINA)

 •A teen girl who’s an agitator through and through. She’s always ready to escalate a joke, even if it’s at the cost of someone else’s feelings. To her, empathy is laughable, and she feels the burning need to be the center of attention. 

KAYLA (16, LATINA)

   •The group's enabler. Often lacking her own opinion, Kayla sticks to whoever she views as the leader in any situation. She does as she's told out of fear of being viewed as different, even if her actions carry out hurtful consequences. 

No minors. Looking for actresses between the ages of 18-25. 

Feel free to email a headshot and reel to moraleslopez@chapman.edu

## **CASTING | KRAKÓW 4.08 – Aktor (Interviewer)**

Hej! Szukam aktora do roli Interviewera w 15-minutowym filmie szkoleniowym z zakresu cyberbezpieczeństwa (szkolenie LMS dla korporacji).
* 📍 **Lokalizacja:** Kraków (szukamy osób z Krakowa – brak zwrotu kosztów dojazdu)
*  📅 **Termin:** 1 dzień zdjęciowy – 4 sierpnia (godz. 8:00–20:00)
* 💰 **Stawka:** 1500 zł netto (pełny wykup / buyout: perpetual, worldwide, all media) - bez widocznego wizerunku

**Kogo szukamy?**
* Mężczyzna (ok. 30–40 lat).
* Rola bez wizerunku – ujęcia wyłącznie zza pleców / zza ramienia.
* Biegły angielski (C1/C2) oraz świetna dykcja i praca głosem – warunek konieczny!
* Doświadczenie przed kamerą / praca na planie.

**Jak się zgłosić?**
* Wyślij maila na: **jankoczur.casting@gmail.com**
* **Temat:** Casting – Interviewer – Imię i nazwisko
* **W treści dołącz:** Imię, wiek, wzrost, miasto, nr telefonu. 2-3 aktualne zdjęcia (twarz + sylwetka). Krótkie demo/self-tape w j. angielskim lub próbka głosu (min. 30 sekund – tekst dowolny). Link do portfolio/showreela (jeśli masz).

Czekam na Wasze zgłoszenia! 😊

**WARSZAWA **

**serial fabularny - STAND INI **

**stawka: 160 zł**

Do serialu fabularnego szukam STAND INA i STAND INKI.

**Stand in** to osoba zastępująca aktora podczas przygotowań technicznych takich jak np. ustawianie oświetlenia czy kadrowanie kamer.
* **STAND IN'KA** - kobieta ok. 20-35 lat, wzrost ok. 166 cm, rozmiar XS, włosy dłuższe ciemny blond.

        **Dni zdjęciowe: 3 sierpnia i będą kolejne**

* **STAND IN **- mężczyzna ok. 20-40 lat, wzrost ok. 183 cm, klatka ok.104 cm, rozmiar L, brunet, włosy dłuższe. Nie długie. Klasyczna fryzura.

        **Dni zdjęciowe: 3, 6, 8, 10 i 11 sierpnia i będą kolejne**

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **ewelina.wika@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **STAND IN**

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość i wymiary: wzrost, klatka/biust, pas, rozmiar ubrania i buta

W załączniku: **zdjęcie twarzy - selfie z dnia zgłoszenia i aktualne zdjęcie sylwetki**

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka.

items.text:
Hello! I am urgently casting extras and a few speaking roles for a fun, micro comedy series filming this weekend!

Please see all info on roles below. This is an UNPAID gig. 

We're casting speaking roles and background extras for a DMV comedy shoot. If you love playing larger-than-life characters, this one's for you.

DENVER DMV is set inside the most delightfully dysfunctional government office in Denver, Colorado.Filmed in the spirit of “The Office” and “Parks & Recreation”, the series follows a quirky cast scrambling to save their jobs as their branch faces shutdown.

FILMING INFO:

Saturday 8/1: Time TBD but it will be a 3 hour window and maybe less.

Compensation: Non-paid

Location: Near downtown Denver

Submissions due by: Wed. 7/29 EOD

Production Company: Neato Pictures

SEND SUBMISSIONS TO: martinalmaio@gmail.com and brandy@neatopictures.com

****Be sure to include your name, phone number, email and availability on 8/1

SPEAKING ROLES: (Please submit photo and video audition)

The Shirtless Renewal Guy (M, 20s-30s) — Just wants his new license photo to really capture his best self. Confidence: 100%. Shirt: optional (in his mind).

Distracted Mom (F, 20s-30s) — Rambunctious young son in tow, phone in hand, mom is anywhere but here. Bonus points if you can ignore chaos with total conviction.

Rambunctious Young Son (M, 3-6) — Toy hammer, zero chill, and a personal mission to bop every stranger in line.

The Fed-Up Customer (F, 30s-50s) — Been waiting forever, gotten nothing but attitude, and is done being polite about it. Spicy, sharp-tongued, no patience left to give.

The Vanity Plate Customer (F, 20s-40s) — Just wants her perfect vanity plate and cannot fathom why the DMV is making this so hard.

The Cool Customer (M, 19-30) — Charming, a little sly, and very confident he can talk the clerk into approving a plate that should absolutely not be approved.

Background Extras (photo submission only)

Everyday DMV customers: the patient ones, the annoyed ones, the ones glued to their phones, and the ones who make you wonder "what's their story?" We want real faces and real energy.

**Berlin  / 15 Kompars*innen als Hochzeitsgesellschaft / 1-2 Drehtage nach Absprache, 31.Juli  & 3. August  / NoBudget (Stud.-Prod.)**

Für einen Debütfilm in Co-Produktion der DFFB und der UDK Berlin sind wir auf der Suche nach Komparserie, die eine Hochzeitsgesellschaft verkörpern kann.

Gedreht wird an zwei Drehtagen:

**31.JULI, CA. 10:00 - 17:45**

**3.AUGUST , CA. 17:00 - 02:45**

Bewerber*innen müssen NICHT an beiden Tagen verfügbar sein, wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit Angabe der Verfügbarkeiten.

Drehort ist Berlin Kreuzberg, es handelt sich um einen Aussendreh.

Wir suchen nach Menschen jeglichen Alters und jeglichen Aussehens.

Leider können wir keine Gage anbieten, für Verpflegung und Vergnügen ist natürlich gesorgt!

·        Körpergröße

·        Telefonnummer

·        Angabe der Verfügbarkeit

An die folgende Email-Adresse: **tretenkomparserie@gmail.com**

**CASTING CALL:**

Hello everyone!

I'm currently casting **Solitaire**, an upcoming independent short film shooting in the GTA this August, and we're looking for talented actors to join our cast.

**Project:** *Solitaire* (Short Film)
**Location:** Greater Toronto Area
**Shoot Dates:** August 17–18 & August 24–25, with a scheduled pick-up day on August 27.
* NON UNION/ NON PAID
* Food and beverages will be provided

If you're interested, you can:
* Apply through our Backstage casting notice:
https://www.backstage.com/casting/solitaire-3199900/

**OR** email your submission directly to **damirshahi@gmail.com** with:
* Headshot
* Resume
* Demo reel (if available)

**ROLE:**

NEIL

GENDER: MALE

AGE: 40-60

A middle-aged (late 40s, early 50s) man who believes he is still a 17-year-old high school student serving detention in 1990. Neil creates an imaginary life for himself in detention, and is kept company by a sock puppet friend, Mikey, whom Neil voices. Neil is easily impressionable, cocky, immature, and not the sharpest tool in the shed.

Thank you, and I look forward to seeing your submissions!

items.text:
Be good at something besides acting be passionate about other things too…

2 days after winning his first Oscar at 31:

Conga time!  #congas #percussion #marlonbrando #Brando #actors

https://youtu.be/ZkF2-ZZSx6k?feature=shared

Trivia:  Marlon Brando

He may not have originated the “method acting” technique, but Marlon Brando was an innovator when it came to his enthusiasm for drumming. Late in life, the Oscar winner devoted his energy to developing a conga drum that could be tuned by way of a single lever at the bottom, as opposed to the usual five or six bolts along the top. Although he received four patents prior to his death in 2004, Brando likely needed to put in more work to make his creation a reality; one drum manufacturer interviewed for a 2011 NPR article indicated that the actor’s design was practical, but not cost-effective enough for production.

Hello,

We are currently looking for an actor or performer for an experimental mixed-media project exploring the limitations and perceptions of gender and the body.

**Performer requirements:**
* Open to actors and performers of any gender
* Must be aged 18 or over
* Must be available for both of the following sessions:
   * Saturday, 15 August, at Belvoir Forest Park
   * One weekday during the first two weeks of August, from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., at Queen’s University Belfast campus

Travel expenses will be covered.

Anyone interested should send a headshot and portfolio or showreel to **[landrews10@qub.ac.uk](mailto:landrews10@qub.ac.uk)**. 

The director will provide further information about the project after initial contact.

If you know anyone who might be interested, we would really appreciate it if you could share this casting call with them.

Best wishes,
Dara

Rachel

🎬🌎 DID YOU KNOW? The World’s Largest Film Competition Has Featured Hollywood Stars! 🌎🎬

This weekend, Virtuoso Productions LLC is proud to compete once again in the Summer 48 Hour Film Project, one of the most exciting filmmaking competitions in the world.

But here’s something many people don’t know…

🎥 Since its founding in 2001, the 48 Hour Film Project has grown into the world’s largest timed filmmaking competition, bringing together thousands of filmmakers in more than 100 cities worldwide. Every team has just 48 hours to write, cast, film, edit, score, and deliver a complete short film from scratch.

⭐ Over the years, the competition has featured some incredible names, including:

🎭 Martin Freeman (The Hobbit, Black Panther, Sherlock)
🎭 J.K. Simmons (Whiplash, Spider-Man, Invincible)
🎭 Dennis Farina (Law & Order, Snatch, Get Shorty)
🎭 Penn Jillette (Penn & Teller)
🎭 Nick Clooney (journalist and broadcaster)

🎬 The competition has also welcomed distinguished judges and mentors, including:

✨ Jane Seymour
✨ Sean Gunn
✨ Dave Costabile
✨ Maggie Lawson
✨ Simon West
✨ Bruce Beresford
✨ Shekhar Kapur
✨ Julianne Moore
✨ Thelma Schoonmaker

🏆 Winning teams advance to Filmapalooza, where city champions from around the world compete on an international stage. Many participating filmmakers have gone on to successful careers in television, feature films, and major film festivals.

For us, this weekend is about more than making a movie.

🎬 Creativity under pressure.
🤝 Building lifelong friendships.
🎭 Discovering new talent.
📖 Telling meaningful stories.
🌟 Representing El Paso with excellence.

📅 OUR WEEKEND SCHEDULE

🎬 Friday, July 31
📍 Team Meeting – 6:30 PM
🎲 Official 48 Hour Film Project Kickoff
📩 DM us for the meeting location if you’d like to join our cast or crew!

🎥 Saturday, August 1
Lights. Camera. Action.
We’ll be filming all day as we race against the clock to bring our story to life.

💻 Sunday, August 2
Editing, scoring, color, sound, and final touches…
⏰ 7:00 PM – Film Submission Deadline

We’re still looking for:
🎭 Actors
🎥 Crew Members
🎬 Production Assistants
📸 Behind-the-Scenes Content Creators
🙌 Background Extras

Whether you’re a seasoned filmmaker or have never been on a movie set before, this is your chance to be part of something unforgettable.

Who knows…

The next award-winning filmmaker, actor, writer, editor, or cinematographer could be standing on our set this weekend.

🎥 48 Hours.
📝 One Story.
🎭 One Team.
💙 Endless Possibilities.

Wish Virtuoso Productions LLC the best as we take on another filmmaking adventure!

items.text:
Hello,

We are currently looking for an actor or performer for an experimental mixed-media project exploring the limitations and perceptions of gender and the body.

**Performer requirements:**
* Open to actors and performers of any gender
* Must be aged 18 or over
* Must be available for both of the following sessions:
   * Saturday, 15 August, at Belvoir Forest Park
   * One weekday during the first two weeks of August, from 6:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m., at Queen’s University Belfast campus

Travel expenses will be covered.

Anyone interested should send a headshot and portfolio or showreel to **[landrews10@qub.ac.uk](mailto:landrews10@qub.ac.uk)**. 

The director will provide further information about the project after initial contact.

If you know anyone who might be interested, we would really appreciate it if you could share this casting call with them.

Best wishes,
Dara

items.text:
K.A. Global Pictures is casting for an upcoming British Feature Television Drama Series currently in development.

We are seeking experienced Male Actors with strong dramatic ability and, ideally, some action or physical performance experience for the following roles:

- 2 x Hard Men
- 1 Corrupt Police Officer (Plain Clothes) 

Due to the confidential nature of the project, further production details will only be disclosed to shortlisted applicants.

This production is being developed by an Award-Winning Writer & Director following the success of a critically praised theatre production that received outstanding audience and industry feedback. The project is now being adapted for the screen and has generated early interest from major broadcasters and streaming platforms.

Inspired by True Events spanning the 1980s through to the present day, this British crime drama blends realism, grit and suspense in the style of Snatch, Gangs of London, The Gentlemen, Essex Boys, Rise of the Footsoldier, This Is Our City, Mobland and Layer Cake.

Genre: Drama | Crime | Thriller

Who We're Looking For?

* British White/Caucasian Male Actors
* Late 30s, 40s and 50s
* London-based applicants preferred
* Previous acting experience essential
* Action or physical performance experience desirable

We're particularly interested in performers who can authentically portray tough, streetwise British characters with confidence and realism. Familiarity with Cockney culture, London "geezer" personalities, British popular culture and the criminal underworld portrayed in classic British dramas is advantageous. Think along the lines of iconic characters such as Phil Mitchell and Grant Mitchell.

Audition Process?

Auditions will be conducted via self-tape.

Successful applicants will progress through the following stages:

* Application review
* Casting interview
* Self-tape audition
* Character discussions and project briefing
* Final casting decisions

Shortlisted actors will also be invited to attend professional character development workshops and rehearsal sessions at our Camden, North London production hub.

Rehearsals & Character Development?

Successful applicants will benefit from:

* Professional character development workshops
* Sessions with experienced acting coaches
* Opportunities to perform in front of visiting industry professionals and talent representatives
* Rehearsals based at our Camden, London hub
* Refreshments and facilities provided
* Full rehearsal schedules issued in advance

Availability?

Applicants should have reasonable flexibility throughout rehearsals and filming. You will not be required every day; however, availability for scheduled rehearsals and production dates is essential.

Filming is expected to take place across London, other parts of the United Kingdom, and potentially overseas.

Compensation?

This is a start-up production currently in development. Production funding and performer contracts will commence once financing and production partnerships have been finalised.

How to Apply?

Please email or DM your application including:

* Headshot
* Full Name
* Telephone Number
* Acting CV, Portfolio, Showreel, Spotlight profile or other professional credentials (where available)

Email: Ahmedsy_jaber@hotmail.com

Serious Applicants Only!

We are moving quickly with this project and are looking for committed, reliable and professional actors who are genuinely interested in becoming part of a long-term television production.

If you know someone who would be suitable, please share this casting opportunity.

Here is Links attached to this post with info of what we are about -

items.text:
**COLD BLOWS THE WIND**

**Independent feature film — now casting**

Shooting in British Columbia, 15 August – 31 October 2026

Somewhere on the coast of British Columbia there is a cove. In that cove, there is a sailboat called Esperanto.

What happened there is disputed. Two old men will tell you one version, loudly, over the top of one another. A

father tells his daughter a gentler one. A woman writes it all down at night and is not certain she believes a word

of it.

There is a mermaid in it. She is several hundred years old and she likes old black-and-white movies.

We are looking for faces with weather in them and voices with some mileage. This is a character piece before it is

anything else — long scenes, real silence, and very little explaining. If that is the work you like, we would like to

see you.

**PLEASE NOTE: MIRA and LITTLE MIRA are two entirely separate characters who happen to share a**

**name. Little Mira is not a younger version of Mira and is not related to her. Please do not submit for both.**

**ROLES**

**MIRA — female, late 20s to 30s, playing ageless. Open ethnicity. LEAD.**

She is several hundred years old and mentions it about as often as anyone else mentions their age. Asked directly,

she lies — smoothly, immediately, and well.

She is not tragic and must not be played tragic. Funny, impatient, jealous, and without a shred of

self-consciousness — she dances when she wants to dance, cooks, picks fights, and is not impressed by anybody.

Charm is the surface. It is not the note.

WATER: strong, confident open-water swimmer. Surf, underwater and cold-water work. Breath-hold comfort

essential. Prosthetic tail and performance work. Freediving, monofin or professional mermaid-performance

experience is a substantial asset — but genuine ease in cold open ocean is the non-negotiable, and it is verified

before callbacks. Please do not overstate it. We would far rather know now.

NUDITY: there is no onscreen nudity. A small number of mermaid sequences are written to imply it and are

achieved entirely through framing, water and camera angle — closed set, discussed in full in advance, covered at

contract. Intimacy in the film is limited and is staged with an intimacy coordinator.

**LITTLE MIRA — female, 7 to 9, to play 8. Open ethnicity. LEAD.**

A serious, watchful, self-possessed child. She corrects adults quietly and without heat. She rations her food. She

holds a conversation with a stray dog and takes it seriously. She notices everything and reports none of it.

She is not precocious and she is not plucky. She is a small person with adult composure, doing something

enormous and telling nobody about it.

Much of the part is silent. There are long passages with no dialogue and no scene partner, where the whole of the

scene is a child thinking. That is the job.

No swimming and no water work of any kind. She should be comfortable outdoors — gravel, forest, weather, and

walking real distances.PARENTS AND GUARDIANS: we are looking for a child who is comfortable being quiet. Who goes still when

she is thinking instead of filling the silence. Who watches a room for a while before she joins it. Children like this

get called shy, or serious, or old for their age.

She does not need experience. No class, no headshot, no set. If she has never once considered acting and you are

reading this because something in it made you think of her — that is the submission we want most.

About the material: this is a drama, and loss is part of the story. The part asks for real feeling. There is nothing

frightening or graphic in it. A guardian is with her throughout, every requirement for working with a minor is

provided for, and we will go through all of it with you properly before any of it reaches her.

Maximum 8-hour days, per BC Employment Standards for performers under 12. Approximately 25–30 shooting

days, dates to be confirmed.

**ISAAK GREY — male, late 30s to 40s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**LEAD.**

A marine biologist. Sometimes. The rest of the time he disappears into the woods for a few months and comes

back broke — his own line, told as a joke, to strangers, at a dinner table.

Charming, self-deprecating, allergic to his own potential. The kind of man who is right about everything except

himself and would rather be liked than believed. He loves the water in a way he cannot make sound reasonable to

anyone.

Both versions of Isaak need to exist in the same actor already — sharp, well-dressed and sure of himself in one

timeline, holes in his shoes in the other.

The problem to solve: playing failure without apologising for it and without winking at us. He knows precisely

what he is. He simply cannot do anything about it.

A distinctive, characterful profile is an asset. A subtle prosthetic is used in one timeline; a broken nose is not a

requirement. Approx. 11 days.

**THOMAS CAINE — male, 70s to play 75. British character; authentic or exceptional British**

**accent required. LEAD.**

A prospector, a raconteur, and a magnificent bullshitter.

Much of this role is direct storytelling — spoken aloud to a listener, at length, and interrupted at every turn by his

partner of forty-odd years. He preaches, he spits, he does voices, he swears in front of children and gets told off

for it, and he is having the time of his life. Then something crosses his face, the performance drops for half a

second, and he picks it back up and carries on.

The problem to solve: holding a room with nothing but a voice, and letting us see — in one unguarded beat

between sentences — what it costs him to keep talking. This is a stage actor’s part. It wants somebody who has

done it in front of people.

Extensive V.O. as well as on-camera work, including some boat and water work. Read in pairs with WALTER at

callbacks. Approx. 9 days.

**WALTER WEIRS — male, 70s. British character; authentic or exceptional British accent**

**required. Genuinely large build. LEAD.**An enormous man with hands like catcher’s mitts and the gentlest disposition in the film. A former fighter who

spent his career ending other men’s brawls rather than starting them — most of them started by Thomas.

His job is to interrupt, correct and soften. Not for accuracy — for fairness. He loses most of these arguments and

goes on making them anyway. Forty years of partnership sit underneath every line and are never once explained.

Physically large, tall and broad, is written into the character and remarked on by others. Warmth is the essential

quality; the size is only interesting because of the care with which he uses it.

If you have spent a career being cast for your size, this is the part where it finally means something else.

Read in pairs with THOMAS at callbacks.

**DEBORAH — female, 40s to 50s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**SUPPORTING.**

A woman who confuses cynicism with wisdom. Quick, funny, socially fearless, and just cruel enough that you

flinch about half a second after you have laughed. Excellent company with a glass of white wine in her hand and

considerably harder to be around at home.

She is not a monster and cannot be played as one. She decided a long time ago that expecting less of people is the

same thing as being clever, and she is quietly handing it on.

The problem to solve: the audience has to like her before they are allowed to be disappointed in her. If they clock

her early, the part is gone.

Partnered with HELEN — read in pairs at callbacks. Established pairs are welcome to submit together.

**HELEN — female, 40s to 50s, playing a span of roughly ten years. Open ethnicity.**

**SUPPORTING.**

Deborah’s partner. Gentle, watchful, nurturing, and considerably tougher than she first appears — she is the one

who laughs a thing away, and also the one who knows exactly what she is laughing away.

The part is small and load-bearing. In a house with very little kindness in it she is the kindness, and she never

once makes a speech about it.

The problem to solve: most of this role is reaction. We are looking for a great listening face — an actress who is

visibly doing something specific while other people talk.

Partnered with DEBORAH — read in pairs at callbacks. Established pairs are welcome to submit together.

**COMPENSATION**

$200 CAD/day flat, all roles — leads and supporting alike. Ten-hour days, paid weekly. Non-union.

Milestone bonuses on top of your fee, tied to money actually arriving rather than paperwork being signed. On the

production’s receipt of distribution revenue, a bonus equal to one times your total engagement fee. On

recoupment of total production cash cost, a further two times. Full terms are set out in the engagement agreement.

Little Mira: maximum 8-hour days, per BC Employment Standards for performers under 12.

**LOCATIONS**Vancouver, BC (Locarno Beach, False Creek, Vancouver Harbour) · Georgia Strait · Gibsons / Desolation Sound

area, BC · BC Ferry (Langdale route). Some work is outside Vancouver. Travel and accommodation details

confirmed on casting.

**TO SUBMIT**

Headshot, resume, and reel or self-tape link to casting@horstcreative.ca

MIRA — please include a brief and candid note on your open-water and cold-water experience, and any

freediving, monofin or breath-hold background.

THOMAS and WALTER, DEBORAH and HELEN — tell us if you are submitting as an established pair.

LITTLE MIRA — parent or guardian only. Send a recent photo and a short video of her talking about something

she likes. No performance necessary. Please don’t rehearse her or prepare anything — we’d rather see her as she

is.

Sides are released to selected submissions. Full script at callback under NDA.

Self-tapes due 7 August. Callbacks 9 August. THOMAS and WALTER open until filled.

**We would rather see one honest read than three polished ones.**

Et si la prochaine rencontre changeait une création… ou le début d'une aventure ? 🍃

La Compagnie Les Ours de Laine ouvre ses portes à des artistes du mouvement : danseurs·ses, circassien·nes, acrobates, cascadeurs·ses, mimes, marionnettistes, interprètes de théâtre physique… et toutes celles et ceux qui aiment raconter par le corps et donner de la voix.

Une matinée de recherche, de training, de partage et de rencontres, en vue de nos prochaines créations et celles en cours.

📍 Paris – début septembre 2026
📩 Candidatures jusqu'au 27 août 2026 (CV + vidéo de présentation ou bande-démo).

➡️ théâtre.physique.contemporain@gmail.com

Si cette annonce peut parler à quelqu'un de votre entourage, n'hésitez pas à la partager. 🌿

Zum Nachhören 

THE STORIES ist ein internationaler Spielfilm  unter der Regie des österreichisch-ägyptischen Regisseurs Abu Bakr Shawky. 💬 Plaudermeeting: Kunst und Wirtschaft – Kooperationen mit Unternehmen 
🎙️ Moderation: Monika Medek 

Ob Sponsoring, Auftragsarbeiten oder CSR-Partnerschaften: Kunst kann für Unternehmen einen echten Mehrwert schaffen – in der Kommunikation, im gesellschaftlichen Engagement, bei der Mitarbeiter*innen-Bindung oder als Impuls für Innovation. 

Doch welche Schnittstellen gibt es zwischen Kultur und Wirtschaft? Welche Kooperationsmöglichkeiten lassen sich entwickeln? Und wie formuliere ich ein Angebot so, dass es für Unternehmen attraktiv, verständlich und relevant ist? 

In diesem interaktiven Plaudermeeting sprechen wir über Strategien, Argumente und konkrete Ansätze, mit denen sich künstlerische Projekte erfolgreich im unternehmerischen Umfeld positionieren lassen. 

Ein Frühstück für alle, die neue Partnerschaften aufbauen, ihre Projekte professionell präsentieren und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Kunst und Wirtschaft aktiv gestalten möchten.

items.text:

🎬mentoring aktorski 
🎬nagranie wizytówek w Warszawie

sharedPost.text:
Chcesz zostać aktorką/aktorem albo mieć więcej aktorskiej pracy ale nie wiesz co konkretnie zrobić? 🤔 Jeżeli tak - zapraszam na konsultacje do mnie, nagranie wizytówek i montaż demo aktorskiego! 🎬🤩 Szczegóły w opisie! 

🎥 Mentoring aktorski 

Dla kogo? 

Dla każdego kto chce pracować jako aktor/aktorka na planach zdjęciowych. Zarówno dla tych bez doświadczenia, któryórzy nie wiedzą jak zacząć i co zrobić jak i dla tych co już pierwsze kroki mają za sobą ale chcieliby mieć więcej pracy i potrzebują rady w tym zakresie 🙂 

Na czym polega? 

Spotkanie ze mną 1:1 online, trwające godzinę. Opowiesz mi jakie zlecenia aktorskie Cię interesują - czyli Twój aktorski cel i według tego dobieramy odpowiedni plan działania. Jeżeli masz materiały aktorskie - to je omówimy i powiem co warto byłoby jeszcze do nich dodać lub jak je “podrasować”. Jeżeli nie masz to dowiesz się co i jak masz zrobić żeby je mieć 🙂 Powiem o moich poleceniach agencji aktorskich, jak samodzielnie i łatwo zrobić demo, jak nagrać i co powiedzieć w wizytówkach, jak samodzielnie szukać pracy, jak się wyceniać, na co uważać. I odpowiem na wszystkie inne Twoje pytania. Po spotkaniu otrzymasz ode mnie maila z planem działania i priorytetami do wykonania + materiałami pomocniczymi dot. materiałów aktorskich. 

🎥 Coaching aktorski z wizytówki + nagranie wizytówek w studio 

Na czym polega? 

✅ Tworzę tekst do wizytówek na podstawie informacji o Twoim doświadczeniu, pasjach, zainteresowaniach, który dostajesz przed nagraniem według castingowych wytycznych, który pokaże Twoje największe atuty

✅W studio nagrań nagrywamy 3-4 wizytówki:

🎬 do filmów i seriali 
🎬 do reklam w wersji dłuższej 
🎬 do reklam w wersji krótszej 
🎬 w języku obcym 
Ewentualnie możemy dograć wizytówkę modelingową 

✅ W trakcie nagrywania zadbam o Twoje rozluźnienie, dobrą atmosferę oraz zrobimy kilka ćwiczeń które pomogą pokazać na wizytówkach Twoją energię i błysk w oku 
oraz będę czuwać nad całym procesem

✅ Wizytówki nagramy według aktualnych standardów i wymogów castingowych 

✅ Dostaniesz zmontowane wizytówki gotowe do wysłania przez WeTransfer

🎥 Demo aktorskie 

montaż demo aktorskiego + konsultacja 

Na czym polega? 

✅ otrzymasz ode mnie demo aktorskie zmontowane zgodnie z obecnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu + podczas konsultacji wspólnie dobierzemy sceny, które się w nim znajdą oraz przedstawię Ci mój pomysł na ich kolejność 

Podczas konsultacji dowiesz się również:

✅ jak pobierać materiały do demo aktorskiego 
✅ jakie są obecne wymogi i standardy wzgledem aktorskiego demo 
✅ jakie sceny wybierać i w jakiej kolejności je zmontować  
✅ jak samemu w łatwy sposób przemontować demo pod konkretny casting 

Szczegóły priv

sharedPost.text:
🎥 Montaż demo aktorskiego z konsultacją 

Potrzebujesz demo aktorskiego, które pokaże Twój talent aktorski i wszechstronność a jednocześnie będzie zgodne z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu? Chcesz dowiedzieć się jak pobierać materiały i jak tworzyć takie demo samemu w przyszłości w łatwy sposób oraz jak zwiększyć swoje szanse na konkretną role? Jeżeli tak to zapraszam do skorzystania z mojej usługi 🙂 

✅ dokładnie przejrzę Twoje aktorskie materiały, wybiorę najlepsze aktorsko sceny oraz różnorodne pod względem emocji i ról

✅ zmontuję demo zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu uwzględniając również to, które sceny Ty uważasz za najlepsze 

✅ podczas konsultacji opowiem Ci o obecnych standardach montażu i doboru scen, dam dużo cennych rad abyś mogła / mógł w przyszłości montować demo samodzielnie 

✅ gotowe demo dostaniesz ode mnie maksymalnie w 2 dni od wysłania mi swoich materiałów

✅ przystępna cena 💵 szczegóły na priv 

Na zdjęciach załączam jedną z wiadomość od klienta po moim montażu 🔥💪 

Uwaga! Nie zajmuję się pobieraniem materiałów.

Betreff: Suche nach einer Wochenend-Camera-Acting-Ausbildung

Ze względu na to, że jest to projekt studencki, udział jest **non-profit**, natomiast zapewniamy transport, wyżywienie na planie oraz miłą atmosferę.

Kilka słów o twórcach:

Poprzedni film reżyserki Agaty Kapuścińskiej i autora zdjęć Mateusza Gzela —„Nibylandex” — był prezentowany m.in. na Krakowskim Festiwalu Filmowym, Festiwalu Polskich Filmów Fabularnych w Gdyni oraz EnergaCAMERIMAGE, a także na trzech festiwalach kwalifikujących do Oscara. Wierzymy, że „Futuria” również ma szansę dotrzeć do szerokiej publiczności i odnieść podobny sukces.

Ekipa filmu ,,FUTURIA”

SAACYF FREE STATE ARTIST PROFILING CAMPAIGN 2026

🟩 Promote Women In Arts  
🟧 Profile Disability Artists  
🟥 Profile LGBTQ+ Artists  
🪘🎭 Embrace African Cultural Attire

The South African Arts & Culture Youth Forum | Free State represents Creative & Cultural Practitioners across the province.  

Our mandate: Revive the Creative Industry. Build the Creative Industry. Create & secure opportunities for people within the industry.

WE WANT TO PROFILE YOU!

Who should apply:
 
Artists | Models | Crafters | Authors | Designers | DJs | Event Organisers | Photographers | Producers | Presenters | Media | Productions | Film Makers | Script Writers | Clap & Taps | Bands | Chorale | Groups | Youth in Arts | Women in Arts | People living with Disability in Arts | LGBTQ+ In Arts | Community Arts Organisations  
ALL ART FORMS WELCOME

Districts Covered:  

☆ Mangaung Metro /Motheo District Municipality 
☆ Fezile Dabi {Mafube, Metsimaholo, Moqhaka & Ngwathe}  
☆ Lejweleputswa {Masilonyana, Matjhabeng, Nala, Tokologo & Tswelopele}  
☆ Thabo Mofutsanyana {Dihlabeng, Maluti a Phofung, Mantsopa, Nketoana, Phumelela & Setsoto}  
☆ Xhariep {Kopanong, Mohokare & Letsemeng}

Hi everyone! My name is Rebecca Walshe, I’m 27 years old, and I’m an actress, aspiring circus artist, and creative based in Worcestershire, West Midlands, UK. I graduated from the University of Wolverhampton in 2022 with a BA in Drama & Musical Theatre.

I’m always looking to connect and collaborate with filmmakers, actors, performers, photographers, and other creatives to bring fresh, exciting ideas to life. Alongside acting, I have a real passion for writing, musical theatre, and the world of circus arts.

I’m particularly drawn to telling unique, compelling stories, especially within the horror genre, and I’m always excited to work on projects that push creative boundaries.

As an aspiring circus artist, I’m currently developing my skills in box illusions, dance, aerial hoop, and LED poi. I’m continually training and learning, and I love exploring new ways to combine performance, storytelling, and circus disciplines.

So far, I’ve had the opportunity to work on three film productions as an extra, as well as working as a magician’s assistant and as one of Santa’s elves during the Christmas season. Each experience has taught me something new, helped build my confidence, and strengthened my passion for performing.

I’m also looking to collaborate with photographers who would like to create new acting headshots or aerial circus photography. If you’re looking to build your portfolio, I’d love to work together and create something exciting that benefits us both.

I’m also passionate about scriptwriting, so if you’re interested in developing a film, short, or creative project together, I’d love to hear from you.

If you’d like to collaborate, please feel free to send me a DM—I’d love to chat! 😊

I’ve included a few photos below and I’m always looking to grow my portfolio while meeting talented, like-minded creatives. I can’t wait to see what we can create together!

🎭 Need an Audition Pep Talk? Tune Into Skipping Through Theatre!
Audition season can be a lot—between learning sides, self-tapes, and waiting by the phone, we get it. 

That’s where Skipping Through Theatre comes in! Hosted by Maddie and Nathan, this award-winning podcast is built by young creatives, for young creatives.

We chat with West End actors, TV stars, and industry insiders to bring you real talk on breaking into the business, surviving the audition grind, and staying inspired.

✨ What you'll get:

- Genuine industry advice from people doing the work right now.

- Unfiltered backstage stories and lessons learned.

- A supportive community that gets the hustle.

🎧 Stream it now on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and YouTube and follow us on TikTok, Instagram and Facebook @skippingthroughtheatre!

Non-Union Casting Call for Short Film “You Are Safe Now”
“A psychological thriller where paranoia and reality become impossible to separate.”

Short Film Logline:

A vulnerable young woman becomes convinced that a group of people are stalking her. Her husband insists it’s the result of her deteriorating mental health. Is she uncovering a terrifying conspiracy—or is she losing her grip on reality?

CASTING FOR TWO LEAD ROLES!

Charlotte

Age Range: 20-30s • Female • Any Ethnicity

Charlotte is a once-promising software engineer whose worsening mental health has left her isolated and working a grocery store job. Intelligent and deeply self-aware, she struggles with growing paranoia while desperately trying to hide the extent of her condition from those around her.

⸻

Lance

Age Range: 20-30s • Male • Any Ethnicity

A successful software engineer who has reluctantly become the caretaker for his wife as her mental health deteriorates. Intelligent and dependable on the surface, Lance harbors growing resentment over the sacrifices he’s made and has begun seeking emotional connection

⸻

SUBMISSIONS

Please send your headshot, acting résumé, and demo reel (if available) to:

aidantimm@peaceofmindpictures.com

Selected applicants will be contacted with audition details.

⸻

SHOOT DETAILS

Type of Project: Psychological Thriller Short Film (Approx. 5 minutes)

Location: Vancouver, BC

Shoot Dates: August 21–23, 2026

Compensation: Unpaid (Passion Project) • IMDb Credit • Meals Provided

⸻

HOW TO SUBMIT

Please email your headshot, résumé, and demo reel (if available) to:

aidantimm@peaceofmindpictures.com

Applicants must be available August 21–23, 2026.

**CASTING CALL - SHORT FILM "FAMILY TIME"**

**Union Status:** UBCP, ULB Under 40 Agreement– Union and Non-Union actors both welcome
**Production Companies:** Wanda Films & Gooseberry Films
**Writer/Director:** Rachelle Younie
**Producer(s):** Rachelle Younie, Maddy Ginn, Kenton Duncan** **

**Synopsis: **At a family reunion hosted by Cathy and Greg in their isolated mountain home, their daughter Phoebe joins cousins Marcus and Darcy and their partners Tara and Simon. When Greg, Marcus, and Simon venture up the mountain with the family dog, Phoebe becomes convinced tragedy is imminent, haunted by the unresolved death of her brother. Hours later, Ruby returns covered in blood, followed by Marcus and Simon carrying Greg's wounded body. As her family collapses in horror, Phoebe experiences an unsettling sense of relief– the catastrophe she feared has finally arrived.

**Shooting Location:** Grand Forks, British Columbia
**Shooting Dates:** September 12-14, 2026
**Audition Format:** Initials via self-tape only, followed by in-person callback
**Self-Tape Submission Deadline: **Friday, August 7, 2026
**In-Person Callbacks:** Monday, August 10, 2026
**Callback Location: **151 West Cordova Street, Vancouver, BC

**Compensation:**
* Rate: $100/day
* All meals provided
* Transportation: Carpool or Gas Reimbursement
* Accommodation: Hotel 
* IMDB credit, demo reel material

**Characters:**
GREG - Man, 55-65, Caucasian, Supporting: Greg is the husband of Cathy and the father of Phoebe. He has little to say to any of his family, feeling like he’s never really known how to be a dad or a member of a functioning family. The reunion ends tragically for Greg.

TARA - Woman, 30-40, Any Ethnicity, Supporting: A reluctant attendee of the reunion, Tara is the new fiancée of Marcus, whose extended family is having the reunion. She only knows parts of the family’s past tragedy, and finds it all very uncomfortable.

**Submission Instructions: **Please submit your resume and headshot as a single PDF document, a link to your demo reel (if applicable), your contact information, and your agent's info (if applicable) to brendan@sadsackcinema.com and indicate which role you're interested in auditioning for. Please label your email subject line: FAMILY TIME – CHARACTER NAME – ACTOR NAME. You will receive an email back with self-tape instructions and sides. Self-tapes due August 7.

**Hiring: Writer-Directors for ReelShow**

Hi everyon. My name is Ethan and I'm the project manager handling hiring for ReelShow. We're a brand new studio building original microdramas and micro series using AI-driven production tools.

We're looking for writer-directors to join our core content team. Each episode runs 70–80 seconds, part of a contained series with a clear beginning, middle, and end. You'll take a script and own it from page to screen by working alongside a small team of AI creators and editors to bring it to life.

What we're looking for:
* Experience writing and producing preferred
* Directing background — film school or equivalent hands-on experience
* Comfort working in a fast-moving, experimental production pipeline
* Based in or able to work with our Hollywood team (remote considered)

This starts as a paid trial period (5–6 weeks) with the opportunity to join the core team if it's a good fit.

If you or someone you know writes and directs and wants in on the ground floor of this, send a reel/samples my way — [17archere@gmail.com](mailto:17archere@gmail.com).

Catalina De La Cruz Studios is officially casting for our upcoming independent feature film, **BINGO, NOT DEAD YET!**

**Project Details**
* **Location:** Metro Atlanta, Georgia
* **Compensation:** Deferred compensation (contingent upon funds raised)
* **Additional Benefits:** On-screen credit, meals provided on set, copy of footage for your acting reel, IMDb credit, and festival exposure
* **Project:** Independent Feature Film

We're looking for talented actors to bring the residents and staff of Sunnyside Senior Living to life!

**LEAD ROLES**

**James Sullivan** – Male, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Mac Callahan** – Male, playing age 50–80 (White)

**SUPPORTING ROLES**

**Debbie Sullivan** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Vinny Moretti** – Male, playing age 50–80 (Italian preferred; Italian American and/or New Jersey accent preferred)

**Kitty** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White preferred, open to all ethnicities)

**Harold White** – Male, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Raj Patel** – Male, playing age 50–80 (South Asian; South Asian accent)

**Raymond "Ray J." Jackson** – Male, playing age 50–80 (Black/African American)

**Vivienne Beaumont** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White preferred, open to all ethnicities)

**Eleanor Briggs** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Patricia "Patty" Miller** – Female, playing age 50–80 (White)

**Leticia Harris** – Female, playing age 25–45 (Black/African American)

**Valerie Torres** – Female, playing age 22–35 (Latina preferred, open to all ethnicities)

**Young James Sullivan** – Male, playing age 18–25 (White)

**Young Mac Callahan** – Male, playing age 18–25 (White)

**Young Debbie Sullivan** – Female, playing age 18–25 (White)

**BACKGROUND ROLES**

**Residents** – Male & Female, playing age 50–80

**Staff** – CNAs, nurses, dining staff, maintenance, reception, and visitors, playing age 18–65

Actors of **all experience levels** are encouraged to submit. Whether you're a seasoned performer or just getting started, we'd love to see your audition.

Know someone who would be perfect for one of these roles? Tag them in the comments or share this post!

Character breakdowns, audition sides, and the submission form are available through the **Casting** tab at the link below.

We look forward to seeing your submissions!

🎬 WARSZAWA – SZUKAM STATYSTÓW DO REKLAMY! 🎬
Cześć Warszawo! 😊

Szukam osób do udziału w planie reklamy. Można zgłaszać się na wybrane dni lub na wszystkie terminy!

📅 03.08 – PONIEDZIAŁEK

👥 Wiek: 20–55 lat

🎭 Rola: przechodnie na osiedlu

⚽ Dodatkowo szukamy:

👨‍⚖️ 1 Pana do roli sędziego

⚽ 3 Panów do roli piłkarzy

🌧️ UWAGA! Zdjęcia będą realizowane w deszczu!

📅 04.08 – WTOREK

👥 Wiek: 25–55 lat

🎭 Rola: przechodnie

📅 05.08 – ŚRODA

👥 Wiek: 20–60 lat

🎭 Rola: goście filharmonii – zdjęcia we wnętrzu

💰 Stawka: 160 zł

💳 Płatne przelewem.

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA:

Proszę wysyłać na adres: plan@filmakcja.pl

📝 W tytule maila proszę wpisać datę/daty, na które Państwo się zgłaszają.

W zgłoszeniu proszę podać:

• imię i nazwisko

• wiek

• numer telefonu

• wyraźne zdjęcie twarzy

• wyraźne zdjęcie sylwetki

⏰ Zgłoszenia przyjmuję do końca dnia w sobotę 01.08.

Od razu przesyłam propozycje do produkcji.

📞 Do wybranych osób odezwę się najpóźniej w niedzielę 02.08.

Czekam na Wasze zgłoszenia! 😊

Marta Filmakcja 🎬🙏☺️

Hejka, SZUKAMY WYJĄTKOWYCH TWARZY! 🤩

Poszukujemy osób z całej Polski, które wyróżniają się charakterystycznymi cechami wyglądu. Szukamy m.in. osób z: 
✨ diastemą, 
✨ piegami, 
✨ burzą loków, 
✨ pieprzykami, 
✨ oraz innymi unikalnymi cechami, które sprawiają, że Wasza uroda jest niepowtarzalna.

Na czym polega projekt? Wasze zdjęcia zostaną wykorzystane przez scenografię. Koncepcja zakłada zestawienie Waszego aktualnego zdjęcia z wizualizacją stworzoną przez AI, przedstawiającą, jak moglibyście wyglądać w przyszłości 🥰☺️

Stawka: 120 zł

Jak się zgłosić? 
Prześlij na maila wiadomość z następującymi danymi:
👉imię i nazwisko,
👉wiek,
👉wzrost,
👉numer telefonu,
👉zdjęcie portretowe,
👉zdjęcie całej sylwetki

💌Zgłoszenia wysyłaj na: ludzie@unagimedia.pl
W tytule wiadomości wpisz: AI

Czekamy na Wasze zgłoszenia! 😊🌺
